hushfacebook.title: v0.19.0
hushfacebook.body:
This one needs Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer, so update Manager before you patch. Posts can get Save and Download buttons under them, and new switches take Like, Comment, Share or Send off posts and reels, hide posts from Pages or drop the dislike on comments. Feed videos can get a cast button, downloads can go to an SD card, and 32-bit phones work now. You can also pick your own badge and logo colors, sort reels by most liked and copy a reel's whole caption.

New in this release

- New `Badge and logo colors` lets you pick your own color for the red count badges on the tabs and for the blue Facebook logo at the top of Home. Type a color code like #2ECC71 in `Badge color` or `Logo color` under Appearance and restart Facebook. Left blank, both keep Facebook's colors, and settings backups carry them (Refs #263).

- Facebook 584.0.0.51.56 now works on 32-bit phones too. The armeabi-v7a Android 11+ bundle, build 475817404, is declared next to the arm64 build 475817393, and every patch applies to it. Contributed by toidicakhia (Refs #254).

- `Hide the Create button` under Tabs and navigation takes the + button for new posts, reels and stories out of the top bar, on both versions of the bar Facebook hands out. It starts off and shows after a restart (Refs #257).

- A reel's More menu has `Copy caption` now. It copies the whole caption, including the part hidden behind See more, so there's no more screenshotting a long caption to get its text. It's on by default, and `Copy reel captions` under Reels and Watch turns it off (Refs #240).

- You can pick a plain home screen icon when you patch. The `Icon style` option of Hushfacebook settings in Morphe draws Facebook's "f" white on black or black on white, and `Facebook colors` (the default) leaves the icon alone. Themed icons on Android 13 and up still work with either one (Refs #278).

- New `Show full post text` puts a long post's whole text in the feed, so there's no See more to tap. It starts off. Turn it on under News feed in Hushfacebook's settings, and the diagnostic report counts each post it kept whole (Refs #268).

- Downloads can go to an SD card. Pick it in `Save on`, right above `Save to` under Downloads, and videos and photos land on the card in the same folders they'd use on the phone. The phone's storage stays the default. If the card is out of the phone, saves go to the phone's storage until you put it back, so a save never fails over a missing card (Refs #274).

- Reels can pause while you read their comments. Turn on `Pause reels while comments are open` under Comments and writing, and a playing reel stops when its comments open and picks up from the same spot when you close them. A reel you start yourself under the comments keeps playing (Refs #266).

- `Words to hide` and `Words that keep a post` have a test box under the list now. Paste a post's text and it says whether that post would hide or stay, and which list decided, using the list as you've typed it so far, before you tap Save. Nothing you paste gets saved, and only its first 16,384 characters are checked.

- `Newest reels first` is called `Sort loaded reels` now, and a `Reels order` row right under it picks how: `Newest` (the old behavior and still the default) or `Most liked`. It still only reorders the reels Facebook has already loaded for you. A reel without the count it's sorted by keeps Facebook's spot for it. Search finds the switch by its old name too, and settings backups carry the order (Refs #134).

- Feed videos can get a cast button. Facebook took its own casting out, so `Cast button on feed videos` under Video and audio puts a button in the video's top right corner that hands it to a casting app you already have, like Web Video Caster, and that app sends it to your TV. It starts off and needs a build with the video download patch. If the video hasn't loaded a file yet, it says so and asks you to play it for a moment first (Refs #182).

- Posts can have Save and Download buttons under them now, next to Like, Comment and Share. `Save button under posts` adds Facebook's own Save button, filled bookmark and all. `Download button under posts` adds a Download button to posts with a video or photos, and it saves them the same way the post's menu does (an album saves every photo). Both are under News feed and start off. Download needs a build with the video or photo download patch, and posts with nothing to save don't get the button. Right below them, `Hide Like under posts`, `Hide Comment under posts`, `Hide Share under posts` and `Hide Send under posts` each take one button out of that row in the feed. Reels get the same under Reels and Watch: `Hide Like on reels`, `Hide Comment on reels` and `Hide Share on reels` take that button off the side of a reel, next to the Save and WhatsApp switches that were already there (Refs #151, Refs #265).

- `Hide dislike on comments` under Comments and writing takes the thumbs-down off comments, the one Facebook puts next to Like on reels and videos. Like and Reply stay. It starts off (Refs #241).

- `Hide posts from Pages` under News feed takes posts written by Pages out of the feed, the Pages you follow included. Friends' and group posts stay, and so does a friend's share of a Page's post. It starts off (Refs #262).

Fixes

- With `See-through bars` on, a blurred strip no longer hangs above the bottom tab bar while it slides away or comes back. The blur used to spread past the bar's edge whenever the bar was partly faded (Refs #250, #124).

- With `Picture-in-picture` off, reels no longer shrink into a floating window when you leave Facebook. Some accounts get Facebook's own version of that window, switched on from Facebook's side or from its Media settings, and it used to slip past the switch (Refs #252, #256).

- With `Open feed videos on their own` on, a regular video post in your feed (one that isn't a reel) starts as fast as it does with the switch off. That now includes video posts you open from inside a group. Their full screen viewer used to sit on a blank loading screen first, for up to a second on the home feed and two seconds or more in a group. Reels you open from the feed still play alone with nothing after them (Refs #237).

- With `Tap to play` on, a video you open from a comment plays in Facebook's full screen player again. It used to sit paused there until you left Facebook and came back (Refs #242).

Other changes

- You need Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer now. The patches are built on Morphe patcher 2.0.1, which uses less memory while patching, and older Managers refuse a bundle built on it, so update Manager first. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 1.19.1 or newer.

- Hush titles are drawn in Facebook's blues now, shifting slowly with a light sheen moving across. That covers the settings bar and search, Hush dialogs, the screen shown when settings can't open, and the lock cover. Every color stays readable on its background in every theme, and the titles keep moving even with Android's animations off.

- Long sections are easier to scan. News feed, Reels and Watch, Video and audio, Appearance and Pause, backup and diagnostics group their rows under small headings like `Content filters`, `Video quality` and `Troubleshooting`, still right on the main page. Where the tab bar sits, what it does while you scroll, which tabs hide and their dots all moved to a new Tabs and navigation section. `Tab bar position` and `Tab bar while scrolling` are each one pick from three now, with Facebook's own behavior first, so the two old switches can't fight each other.

- A few names got clearer. Playback is Video and audio, Links is Links and sharing, Chats is Chats and Messenger, and Set when you patched is Built-in changes. Writing joined Comments, and the quality row reads `Default quality`. Search still finds everything by its old name. `Save crashes to Downloads` moved from Privacy to Troubleshooting, right above Pause, and Support keeps help and restart apart from supporting the project.

- `Hide posts with words you choose` now reads a shared link's headline and the line under it too, so a news post whose only mention of a word is in its link preview hides. That includes the newer cards Facebook draws from its own layout, where the headline isn't a plain field. A keep word on the preview still keeps the post (Refs #255).

- The `Only from a reel's More menu` description says which reels get the Picture-in-picture row. Upright reels do, wide ones never did, and the old wording made a missing row look like a bug (Refs #252).

- Patching with `Material You theme` on is faster. Its scans now skip the parts of Facebook they can't change, and the patched app comes out the same as before (Refs #236).

- The README now explains how to go back to an earlier release that lists your Facebook version. You add its bundle as a local source in Manager, patch with the same key and install over your copy. Sign-in and settings stay, and the README lists what `Export settings` leaves out. The steps follow Manager 2.2's own screens and cover what to do when Manager reports a Package conflict instead of installing.

- `Accent color` works with the Material You theme now. It used to sit greyed out whenever Material You was patched in. Now the color you pick replaces your wallpaper's accent and the wallpaper's greys stay, while the first choice, `Wallpaper accent`, keeps the phone's own. It's picked in Hushfacebook's settings under Appearance with no repatch, and Facebook picks it up after a restart (Refs #272).

Behind the scenes

- A device walk no longer fails a page because something an earlier step left open is sitting on top of it. On the S22 the long press on a reel left a comment sheet over the next page, and the Notifications step failed on two walks in a row. When a page can't be confirmed, the walk now presses Back once and opens the link again. Checked in the audit's tests.

hushmessenger.title: v0.28.0
hushmessenger.body:
HushMessenger for Messenger 585.0.0.53.94, all 7 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. 71 patches. The bundle is signed now, and new switches save the voice messages you play, put gallery picks straight into the chat and let calls from chosen people come in without a ring. Material You takes your own colors, and the settings speak Vietnamese. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Quiet incoming calls` has a new **Only chosen chats** switch under it. Turn it on, then pick from the people who called you lately (they're listed newest first), and only their calls come in without a ring. Everyone else rings as usual. Refs #117.
- `Android Auto messages` is a new switch under Conversations. Android Auto only reads a message out and takes a spoken reply when the notification has a mark-as-read action, and Messenger's don't, so Auto fell back to treating them as plain alerts. With the switch on, each message notification carries Messenger's own car mark-as-read as an action you never see on the phone, right next to Messenger's Reply. Android Auto only lists apps installed from the Play Store until you turn on Unknown sources in its developer settings. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #75.
- `Hide the Instants button` is a new switch under Inbox. It hides the + button that slides in at the right edge of your chat list and opens Instants, on every 585 build. Not every account gets that button, so the switch is experimental. Refs #118.
- `Hide the Instants button` also covers the Instants button under your chat heads, the one that sits right where your thumb goes when you reach for a chat. Refs #104.
- `Save voice messages you play` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Each voice message you play also lands in Recordings/Messenger on your phone (Music/Messenger on Android 10 and 11), so a file manager or another player can open it later. Playing the same one again doesn't make a second copy. It needs Android 10 or newer and starts off. Refs #90.
- `Put gallery picks in the chat` is a new switch under Photos and videos that goes with `Open your gallery app`. What you pick in your gallery app goes straight into the chat you came from, above the message box, instead of Messenger's editor or the Send to sheet. Pick one photo or a dozen, then tap Send when you're ready. Nothing goes out on its own. It also brings that row above the message box to accounts where Messenger hadn't turned it on yet. A chat that was already open when you flipped the switch needs opening again. Starts off. Refs #101.
- HushMessenger's settings speak Vietnamese when your phone is set to it, in any region. Thanks to @hautv404 for the translation. Refs #113.
- **GmsCore support** is a new patch that starts unselected, for phones running microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Messenger asks microG-RE for its push token, so it can stay signed in. It's experimental. Leave it out on a phone with Play services. Refs #119.
- Material You can use your own colors now. Under Appearance, copy a theme like `{"name": "Sunset", "accent": "#E1306C", "neutral": "#1A1418", "pure_black": true}` and tap **Use copied theme**. The accent replaces Messenger's blues and the neutral tints its grays and backgrounds in dark mode, at Messenger's own brightness so text stays readable. **Copy theme** hands you the colors in use to tweak or share, and **Back to wallpaper colors** drops it. Refs #115.
- `Keep a message log` marks a message Unsent when the sender takes it back, encrypted chats included, and the log page has a **Show only unsent** button for finding them. With `Keep unsent messages` on, it also tries to keep an unsent message's notification up, even when it was the only message the notification showed, since an encrypted chat can't keep the message on screen. That notification part is experimental. Refs #70.
- The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager 2.3 and newer checks the signature inside the `.mpp` before it loads HushMessenger, and once it has seen this key it won't take a bundle signed with another one. Manager shows the key as `4d8d c2b3 fbcd 3ab6`, and the README has a command for checking a download by hand. Older Managers don't look at it.

### Fixes and changes

- On a Samsung phone, `Bold and italic text` now tells you where to switch Bold and Italic on. Samsung keeps other apps' entries out of the text menu until you tick them under the three dots and Manage apps, so turning on the switch alone looked like it did nothing. Refs #42.
- The README's troubleshooting list now covers a login that gets past the password and then loops on a browser check. That's an account with a passkey, and removing the passkey on the web lets Facebook fall back to approving the login from another device. Refs #108.
- HushMessenger now targets Messenger 585.0.0.53.94 and takes all 7 builds APKMirror lists for it, five for arm64 and two for armv7. 584.1.0.61.98 is no longer supported, so update Messenger before you patch. Each build was checked patch by patch, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt every one of them.
- `Hide Facebook shortcuts` now also hides the View profile button under the person's name and picture at the top of a chat with no messages yet. It opened their Facebook profile. With `Keep the Profile button` on, that one stays too.
- `Hide inbox tabs` now says what it hides on 585: the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. The old text named Home and Channels tabs Messenger doesn't show anymore. Checked on 585, where On hides the tabs and Off or Pause brings them back.
- With `Open your gallery app`, a photo or video you pick in Google Photos that's already saved on your phone now reaches Messenger as the phone's own copy, which Messenger reads with its own photo and video access. Before, the upload had to go through Google Photos' permission. Items that only live in the cloud, and anything Messenger can't open itself, go through as picked. Refs #103.
- Opening a new issue on GitHub now offers a bug report form and a feature request form. The bug form asks for your versions, how you got your patched Messenger (Morphe Manager, Morphe Desktop, morphe-cli or a prebuilt APK), which patches source you added, the phone and where in Messenger it happened, so a report can be looked into without a round of questions first. Other sources carry HushMessenger's patches built from other code, and the source address tells them apart. **App > Report a problem** still opens a blank issue with those facts already filled in.
- The README's Install step says what Manager 2.3 and newer shows as this project's signing key, and its Help section explains the "Key changed" badge. It means the bundle was signed with another key and came from somewhere other than this source, so remove that source and add this one again instead of tapping Trust.
- The README's Help section explains why videos can go missing from Messenger's own picker on Android 14 and newer: with Messenger's photo access set to "Allow limited access" the picker shows only the items you chose. "Allow all" or `Open your gallery app` brings them back. Refs #114.
- With `Square profile pictures` on, the story ring around a picture in your chat list is square too, or rounded with **Round the corners**, so it hugs the picture instead of circling it. A ring that's still filling in follows the same edge. The ring part is experimental. Refs #116.
- `Hide stories and notes` also takes away the story rings around people's pictures in your chat list, the colored circle that says someone posted. It works with or without `Square profile pictures`, and like the square ring it's experimental. Refs #118.
- The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.1.0 now, the patcher that comes with Morphe Manager 2.3.0 and Morphe Desktop 1.20.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.3.0 or newer, or Desktop to 1.20.0, before you add this release.

### Behind the scenes

- The release check reads the bug form's version placeholder and refuses a release where it names another HushMessenger version or a Messenger build the bundle doesn't target. Prepare moves it along with the README.
- The release check reads which patcher built the bundle from its manifest and wants the README to ask for the first Morphe Manager and Morphe Desktop that come with it. Install steps can't send anyone to a Manager too old to load the release. Between releases the README keeps naming what the published release needs.
- The release check refuses a bundle holding a class file compiled for anything newer than Java 17 and names the entry, since morphe-patcher 2.1 won't load one. Entries under `META-INF/versions/` are left alone, as the patcher leaves them.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` now patches the stock APK of the build the device already runs when you don't pass `-Apk`. It reads the installed version code and picks that build from `HUSH_NATIVE_FIXTURES`, so the install no longer dies on `INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE` or lands a different ABI or screen density. When no fixture is that build, it stops and says which builds it has.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` now waits up to 90 seconds after it installs Messenger, until the chat list or the restore prompt shows. The first start after an update upgrades Messenger's data, and until that's done a chat link opens a blank screen. On an x86_64 emulator, a crash inside the emulator's ARM translator while Messenger forks a helper process is still reported, but it no longer counts as a Messenger crash, since a phone doesn't run that translator.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` closes the keyboard before it reads each screen. A chat with no messages yet puts the cursor in the message box, the keyboard comes up, and with it open the screen read failed, so the walk reported the chat as having no screen to check. The keyboard can also come up a moment after the chat loads, so the walk checks again after closing it and tries the screen read up to three times.
- Publish now writes the GitHub release notes in the layout v0.27.0's notes were redone in by hand. They open with the release summary, then carry every CHANGELOG bullet word for word under New in this release, Fixes and changes and Behind the scenes, followed by the reports the release touched, How to update, and What was checked, which comes from the walk that cleared the bundle. Publish stops before tagging when a bullet would go missing or a line uses a dash.
- The release check refuses a bundle that isn't signed, was signed with a key other than the one in `morphe-signing.pub`, or was changed after signing. It also wants that key in the source's `public_key` and its fingerprint in the README. `release.ps1` reads the private key from `-BundleKey` and the build signs with it, while everyday builds without the key stay unsigned.
- The settings screen's code is split up. Auto reply's sheet, the message log viewer, theme colors, the choices backup, the custom font rows, the update check and Copy setup each have a file of their own now, which takes the settings page itself from about 3,600 lines to about 1,500. Nothing you see or tap changed.
- The build moved to Gradle 9.8.2 and Kotlin 2.4.21, both bugfix releases. The patches used to mix Kotlin 2.4.20 and 2.4.21 across the compiler, plugin and library, and now one version covers all three. The bundle's classes still target Java 11.

### Reports this release changed something for

#42, #70, #75, #90, #101, #103, #104, #108, #113, #114, #115, #116, #117, #118 and #119.

Full history is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 585.0.0.53.94 first. Any build on [APKMirror's 585.0.0.53.94 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-585-0-0-53-94-release/) works, and a `nodpi` one keeps the icons sharp.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.3.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **71 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.28.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 1.20.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 7 Messenger 585.0.0.53.94 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 4 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.

- **GmsCore support** is a new patch that starts unselected, for phones running microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Messenger asks microG-RE for its push token, so it can stay signed in. It's experimental. Leave it out on a phone with Play services. Refs #119.
- Material You can use your own colors now. Under Appearance, copy a theme like `{"name": "Sunset", "accent": "#E1306C", "neutral": "#1A1418", "pure_black": true}` and tap **Use copied theme**. The accent replaces Messenger's blues and the neutral tints its grays and backgrounds in dark mode, at Messenger's own brightness so text stays readable. **Copy theme** hands you the colors in use to tweak or share, and **Back to wallpaper colors** drops it. Refs #115.
- `Keep a message log` marks a message Unsent when the sender takes it back, encrypted chats included, and the log page has a **Show only unsent** button for finding them. With `Keep unsent messages` on, it also tries to keep an unsent message's notification up, even when it was the only message the notification showed, since an encrypted chat can't keep the message on screen. That notification part is experimental. Refs #70.
- The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager 2.3 and newer checks the signature inside the `.mpp` before it loads HushMessenger, and once it has seen this key it won't take a bundle signed with another one. Manager shows the key as `4d8d c2b3 fbcd 3ab6`, and the README has a command for checking a download by hand. Older Managers don't look at it.

### Fixes and changes

- On a Samsung phone, `Bold and italic text` now tells you where to switch Bold and Italic on. Samsung keeps other apps' entries out of the text menu until you tick them under the three dots and Manage apps, so turning on the switch alone looked like it did nothing. Refs #42.
- The README's troubleshooting list now covers a login that gets past the password and then loops on a browser check. That's an account with a passkey, and removing the passkey on the web lets Facebook fall back to approving the login from another device. Refs #108.
- HushMessenger now targets Messenger 585.0.0.53.94 and takes all 7 builds APKMirror lists for it, five for arm64 and two for armv7. 584.1.0.61.98 is no longer supported, so update Messenger before you patch. Each build was checked patch by patch, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt every one of them.
- `Hide Facebook shortcuts` now also hides the View profile button under the person's name and picture at the top of a chat with no messages yet. It opened their Facebook profile. With `Keep the Profile button` on, that one stays too.
- `Hide inbox tabs` now says what it hides on 585: the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. The old text named Home and Channels tabs Messenger doesn't show anymore. Checked on 585, where On hides the tabs and Off or Pause brings them back.
- With `Open your gallery app`, a photo or video you pick in Google Photos that's already saved on your phone now reaches Messenger as the phone's own copy, which Messenger reads with its own photo and video access. Before, the upload had to go through Google Photos' permission. Items that only live in the cloud, and anything Messenger can't open itself, go through as picked. Refs #103.
- Opening a new issue on GitHub now offers a bug report form and a feature request form. The bug form asks for your versions, how you got your patched Messenger (Morphe Manager, Morphe Desktop, morphe-cli or a prebuilt APK), which patches source you added, the phone and where in Messenger it happened, so a report can be looked into without a round of questions first. Other sources carry HushMessenger's patches built from other code, and the source address tells them apart. **App > Report a problem** still opens a blank issue with those facts already filled in.
- The README's Install step says what Manager 2.3 and newer shows as this project's signing key, and its Help section explains the "Key changed" badge. It means the bundle was signed with another key and came from somewhere other than this source, so remove that source and add this one again instead of tapping Trust.
- The README's Help section explains why videos can go missing from Messenger's own picker on Android 14 and newer: with Messenger's photo access set to "Allow limited access" the picker shows only the items you chose. "Allow all" or `Open your gallery app` brings them back. Refs #114.
- With `Square profile pictures` on, the story ring around a picture in your chat list is square too, or rounded with **Round the corners**, so it hugs the picture instead of circling it. A ring that's still filling in follows the same edge. The ring part is experimental. Refs #116.
- `Hide stories and notes` also takes away the story rings around people's pictures in your chat list, the colored circle that says someone posted. It works with or without `Square profile pictures`, and like the square ring it's experimental. Refs #118.
- The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.1.0 now, the patcher that comes with Morphe Manager 2.3.0 and Morphe Desktop 1.20.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.3.0 or newer, or Desktop to 1.20.0, before you add this release.

### Behind the scenes

- The release check reads the bug form's version placeholder and refuses a release where it names another HushMessenger version or a Messenger build the bundle doesn't target. Prepare moves it along with the README.
- The release check reads which patcher built the bundle from its manifest and wants the README to ask for the first Morphe Manager and Morphe Desktop that come with it. Install steps can't send anyone to a Manager too old to load the release. Between releases the README keeps naming what the published release needs.
- The release check refuses a bundle holding a class file compiled for anything newer than Java 17 and names the entry, since morphe-patcher 2.1 won't load one. Entries under `META-INF/versions/` are left alone, as the patcher leaves them.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` now patches the stock APK of the build the device already runs when you don't pass `-Apk`. It reads the installed version code and picks that build from `HUSH_NATIVE_FIXTURES`, so the install no longer dies on `INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE` or lands a different ABI or screen density. When no fixture is that build, it stops and says which builds it has.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` now waits up to 90 seconds after it installs Messenger, until the chat list or the restore prompt shows. The first start after an update upgrades Messenger's data, and until that's done a chat link opens a blank screen. On an x86_64 emulator, a crash inside the emulator's ARM translator while Messenger forks a helper process is still reported, but it no longer counts as a Messenger crash, since a phone doesn't run that translator.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` closes the keyboard before it reads each screen. A chat with no messages yet puts the cursor in the message box, the keyboard comes up, and with it open the screen read failed, so the walk reported the chat as having no screen to check. The keyboard can also come up a moment after the chat loads, so the walk checks again after closing it and tries the screen read up to three times.
- Publish now writes the GitHub release notes in the layout v0.27.0's notes were redone in by hand. They open with the release summary, then carry every CHANGELOG bullet word for word under New in this release, Fixes and changes and Behind the scenes, followed by the reports the release touched, How to update, and What was checked, which comes from the walk that cleared the bundle. Publish stops before tagging when a bullet would go missing or a line uses a dash.
- The release check refuses a bundle that isn't signed, was signed with a key other than the one in `morphe-signing.pub`, or was changed after signing. It also wants that key in the source's `public_key` and its fingerprint in the README. `release.ps1` reads the private key from `-BundleKey` and the build signs with it, while everyday builds without the key stay unsigned.
- The settings screen's code is split up. Auto reply's sheet, the message log viewer, theme colors, the choices backup, the custom font rows, the update check and Copy setup each have a file of their own now, which takes the settings page itself from about 3,600 lines to about 1,500. Nothing you see or tap changed.
- The build moved to Gradle 9.8.2 and Kotlin 2.4.21, both bugfix releases. The patches used to mix Kotlin 2.4.20 and 2.4.21 across the compiler, plugin and library, and now one version covers all three. The bundle's classes still target Java 11.

### Reports this release changed something for

#42, #70, #75, #90, #101, #103, #104, #108, #113, #114, #115, #116, #117, #118 and #119.

Full history is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 585.0.0.53.94 first. Any build on [APKMirror's 585.0.0.53.94 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-585-0-0-53-94-release/) works, and a `nodpi` one keeps the icons sharp.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.3.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **71 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.28.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 1.20.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 7 Messenger 585.0.0.53.94 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 4 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.

hushfeed.title: v0.79.0
hushfeed.body:
Hushfeed v0.79.0 has 141 patches. 140 of them are for global TikTok 47.5.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`), and 95 work on PineDrama 47.5.3, one of those made just for it. It needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer, since it's built on patcher 2.0.0.

TikTok stays on 47.5.3, so the TikTok APK you already have is fine to patch again. PineDrama moves to 47.5.3, so grab that one from APKMirror before you patch it. PineDrama got a lot of attention in this one. Six more patches run on it, and photo comments and imported fonts work there now. On TikTok there's a spam comment filter and a way to record a LIVE straight off the screen, and `Hide videos you have already seen` keeps watched videos out of For You again.

Here's every report this release changed something for, and what changed.

For bug reports

* Repeats in For You (#172). `Hide videos you have already seen` checks each new For You page once TikTok hands it over, so videos you watched stop coming back.
* The comment bar on photo posts (#171). With `AMOLED dark theme`, the `Add comment...` bar under a photo post is black instead of letting the photo show through.
* Fonts on PineDrama (#243). `Use an imported font` now draws PineDrama's text in your font, and bold text stays bold.
* Missing saved stickers (#214). PineDrama's sticker panel loads every sticker you saved. It used to stop at 100.
* Low download quality (#240). When the quality list stops below 720p, it also offers the video's own H.264 or HEVC file if that one is taller, and the diagnostic report shows why each quality was or wasn't offered.
* Commenter countries (#201). `Show where commenters are from` remembers people's countries from their earlier comments and videos, so it finds one more often.
* Running out of memory while patching (#220). The README says to give morphe-desktop 2 GB with `java -Xmx2g`.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). A search result you open again clears again, even if you brought its buttons back by hand last time.

For feature requests

* PineDrama (#156). It moves to 47.5.3, six more patches run on it, and a new `Allow photo comments` patch lets the comment box ask TikTok's server about photo comments like TikTok does. Hushfeed's settings also say to restart PineDrama now, not TikTok.
* A spam shield for comments (#187). `Hide spam comments` hides the bots that point you to their bio or hand out a contact, and leaves the creator's own comments alone.
* Effects that refuse older phones (#176). `Report a newer phone to effects` tells the effects server you have a Galaxy S24 Ultra.
* Saving LIVEs (#37). `LIVE recording source` can record the screen as you watch, and Share > Video quality now shows in gaming and football rooms too.
* LIVE recording presets (#203). `LIVE recording quality` offers Original, 1080p, 720p, 540p and 360p and takes a room's 60 fps stream when it has one. You can change it from a LIVE room's Share sheet too.
* The liquid glass bar (#231). `Blur the video behind the bar` frosts the pill with the video under it, and the lens slides between tabs every time now.
* Dark LIVE rooms (#159). The light bits left in rooms turn dark, from the profile card's tiles to the menu's navigation bar, and a room stays dark when your phone switches themes.
* The Auto scroll switch on foldables (#234). `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` hides the switch beside the avatar too, with or without Auto-advance.
* OmerKurdi79's batch (#232). Clear display lets go with your swipe, and the See-through bottom bar no longer drops the caption over the tabs after each swipe.
* An instant pause (#239). With double tap set to do nothing, a tap pauses or plays the moment your finger lifts.
* Latest on Following (#226). `Latest first` keeps everything below your video in date order as posts load, and the tab starts on the newest post.
* Better sorting (#180). Profile grids get Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid loads up to 300 videos by itself, and swiping through them keeps that order.
* Stories from LIVE creators (#233). `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` opens their Story from their profile picture or your chat with them, and the next tap joins the LIVE.
* LIVE quality in dark mode (#57). The newer Video quality picker in a LIVE room's menu is readable on dark mode.
* Add to Story (#88). `Allow Add to Story anyway` brings the button back when a creator turned off content reuse.
* Time zones (#184, #198). With `Match locale and timezone` on, chat dates follow the preset's zone.
* Thoughts (#186). `Turn on Thoughts` shows Thoughts for accounts TikTok left out.
* Original image formats (#229). Stickers that don't move are saved as TikTok sent them too.
* Camera brightness (#200). `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` also covers the front flash and the fill light.
* Region locked features (#98). Feature Gate Lab's `Scrolling comments on videos` preset says up front that only some videos get scrolling comments.

## What's changed

* On PineDrama, Hushfeed's settings now tell you to restart PineDrama instead of TikTok. That covers the note under each switch, the restart button that shows up once you flip one, the saved message and the Feature Gate Lab, in English and all nine translations. Other mentions of TikTok, like its servers or the TikTok Sans font, stay as they are (#156).
* New `Hide spam comments` switch in Hushfeed settings > Comments, off by default (#187). It hides bot comments that send you to their profile or a "link in bio", spell out a website, hand out a Telegram or WhatsApp contact, or offer free followers. It knows the common phrasings in English and the languages Hushfeed's settings come in, plus French. Your own comments stay, and so do the creator's and any they pinned or liked, so a "part 2 in my bio" from the creator still shows.
* `Hide videos you have already seen` takes watched videos out of For You again (#172). TikTok reads each new page once before handing it to the feed. The switch sits that first read out, as it does on lists you open yourself, but everything the read kept was then remembered as allowed and never checked again. Now the page gets checked against what you've watched once TikTok hands it over, and your watch record starts loading during that first read so it's ready in time.
* With AMOLED dark theme, the `Add comment...` bar under a photo post you open from search, a profile or a link is black now (#171). TikTok leaves that bar see-through, and a photo runs on underneath it, so the photo showed through where a video post shows black.
* `Use an imported font` now works on PineDrama (#243). PineDrama doesn't carry TikTok's own fonts, so its text fell back to your phone's font and the imported one never got used. It now draws in your font at the weight the app asked for, so bold text stays bold.
* Feature Gate Lab's `Scrolling comments on videos` preset tells you before you apply it that comments only scroll on videos TikTok has turned them on for. Each video carries its own flag from TikTok's server, so most videos look the same with the preset on (#98).
* New `Allow photo comments` patch for PineDrama, with its switch off by default (#156). PineDrama hides the gallery tab in the comment box for everyone, even though TikTok's server allows photo comments. Turn the switch on in Hushfeed settings > Comments and restart, and the comment box asks the server like TikTok does.
* PineDrama moves to 47.5.3 and 47.4.3 is dropped, so grab the new PineDrama from APKMirror before you patch it again. Six more patches run on it now: `Advanced downloads`, `Automatic video advance`, `Hide inbox items`, `Hide profile shortcuts`, `Open the comments at full height` and `Show the progress bar`. PineDrama 47.5.3 has no stories, HD upload choice or foldable comment panel, so `Story controls`, `Always upload in HD` and `Foldable split comment view` are TikTok only now. That makes 95 patches Morphe Manager offers for PineDrama. The rest lean on TikTok's LIVE rooms, feed buttons or resources that PineDrama doesn't have (#156).
* New `Report a newer phone to effects` switch, off by default (#176). Effects ask TikTok's server whether your phone can run them, and on some older phones the answer is "This effect doesn't work on this device". With the switch on, the effects server is told you have a Galaxy S24 Ultra. Sign-in and everything else still see your real phone. An effect your phone really can't run may still fail or look wrong.
* New `Load all saved stickers` patch, with no switch. PineDrama's sticker panel loaded only the first 100 stickers you saved and never asked for more, so the rest were missing from Saved. It now asks for all of them in one go. TikTok gets the same first request, and it still loads more by itself past that (#214).
* New `LIVE recording source` choice under `Record LIVEs you watch`. `Stream only` saves the room's own video like before. `Screen` records what your phone shows while you watch. Android asks to allow screen recording each time, and Stop saves it. The app's sound comes along when TikTok has the microphone permission, otherwise the recording is video only (#37).
* New `Blur the video behind the bar` switch under `Liquid glass look`. It frosts the glass pill with a soft blur of the video behind it, off by default, on Android 12 and up (#231).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the light pieces left in a LIVE room go dark too. The navigation bar under the menu a long press in a room opens stays dark now, even when TikTok turns it light again. The tiles in the host's profile card and the fan club's tab strip and card turn dark, and the text and icons on them turn light so they stay readable (#159).
* `Tag saved videos with their details` now tags the videos TikTok actually sends. Their files carry a short list of TikTok's own fields where the tags go, and the switch left those files alone, so every save came out with no title, creator, date or link. The tags go in now, and TikTok's fields stay in the file beside them.
* `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the Auto scroll switch that tablets and unfolded foldables show beside the avatar on each video, and it works with `Auto-advance videos` off now. Before, that switch stayed, and the hide only worked while Auto-advance was on (#234).
* The README's install steps now say which 47.5.3 file to get. Morphe Manager on a phone should patch the bundle (`.apkm`), because on a device with 3 GB Manager ran out of memory on the APK and patched the bundle in about a minute. A computer should patch the APK. The out of memory tip under Patching stalls partway points to the bundle too, and step 6 says to uninstall the Google Play TikTok first, which logs you out.
* With `Keep Clear display across videos` off, the tabs, the caption and the buttons now come back as your swipe lets go, so the next video arrives with them. Before, it settled full screen first and then jumped when they showed up again. A Clear display you turn on from TikTok's long-press menu also stays on now instead of switching itself off as the menu closes (#232).
* With `See-through bottom bar` on, the caption, the buttons and the search bar don't drop down over the tabs for a moment after each swipe anymore (#232).
* Long press set to `Save the frame on screen as a photo` works again on 47.5.3. TikTok's player now draws each video into a layer of its own under the feed, so the save only found an empty view and said the frame couldn't be read. It reads the player's layer now, and the photo comes out at the video's own size with no caption or buttons, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile.
* `Remove feed ads` also takes out the smaller Lemon8 card in For You, the one titled "Your daily dose of inspiration" with a Lemon8 post and Open Lemon8 under it. It's built differently from the full-screen Lemon8 card the switch already removed, so it slipped through on 47.5.3.
* The `Show how many were filtered` label and the `Show what is left of the budget` label stay off the Shop tab and the Nearby tab now. Both showed there because the Home tab stays selected on those tabs, and the filtered count sat right over their search boxes. They still show on For You and Following.
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a room's viewer ranking opens dark again. A shop room's Top customers ranking still keeps TikTok's light look, because its tab titles came out dark on dark (#159).
* The README says how much memory morphe-desktop needs on a computer. With every patch picked on 47.5.3 it runs out at 1 GB, Java's default on a 4 GB machine, and finishes at 1.5 GB, so start it with `java -Xmx2g` (#220).
* With `Double tap` set to `Do nothing`, or every corner of `Double tap by corner` set to it, a tap on a video pauses or plays the moment your finger lifts. TikTok used to hold each tap for a beat in case a second one followed, and two quick taps counted as a double tap that did nothing. Now each one counts (#239).
* The build uses Gradle 9.8.2, up from 9.7.1. The build files now name the Guava advisory by its CVE number, CVE-2026-102554, because GitHub's global advisory database doesn't list its GHSA id.
* The README now lists the parts of Hushfeed's settings that an add-on bundle patched in beside it can count on, and a test fails if one of them changes. Anything else in the settings code can still move between releases.
* What's new now carries only the newest releases' notes, and its Full changelog button has the rest. Every release since 0.60.0 used to be built in, in all nine languages, and those notes alone were about 14% of the extension's size.
* `Glass lens on the current tab` slides to the next tab even after you've sat on one tab for a while, or when TikTok takes a moment to open a tab for the first time. Before, it only slid when you tapped quickly, and in both of those cases it jumped instead (#231).
* With `Automatic Clear display` on, a search result you open again from TikTok's own search clears again, even when you brought its buttons back by hand the last time you watched it. Before, it remembered that and stayed uncleared (#84).
* `LIVE recording quality` also offers the presets from a LIVE room's own quality menu: Original, 1080p, 720p, 540p and 360p. If the room doesn't have the one you picked, the recording takes the closest one below it, or the closest above when nothing lower is there. A room's 60 fps streams count as the quality they're in, so 1080p in a 1080p60 room records the 60 fps stream instead of falling back to 720p (#203).
* When the Download quality list stops below 720p, it now also offers the video's own H.264 or HEVC version if that one is taller. The diagnostic report has a new section for the last video you opened the list on, with each quality it offered and why any others were left out (#240).
* `Show where commenters are from` finds a country more often. It remembers someone's country from their earlier comments and from videos of theirs you scrolled past, and it reads one more of the country fields TikTok sends with an account (#201).
* `Latest first` on the Following tab now keeps everything below the video you're watching in date order as more posts load. A newer post that shows up late moves up right after your video, and nothing you've already scrolled past moves. It also asks TikTok for twice as many posts on the first load, so a newer post is less likely to turn up after the first video is already playing. When TikTok opens fresh, it no longer starts the Following tab on the post it saved from last time, which was usually older than everything loading under it. The first video now comes from the new, sorted list (#226).
* Sorting a profile or Liked grid now has Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid keeps loading by itself (up to 300 videos) so the order covers more than the first screen, and a button in the grid's corner changes the order right there. When you open a video from a sorted grid, swiping up goes on in the grid's order too, where it used to follow TikTok's. On the Liked tab the button sits under TikTok's note about who can see your liked videos instead of covering it (#180).
* New switch under `Remove avatar rings`: `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE`. When someone who's LIVE also has a Story, tapping their picture on their profile or on your chat with them in the Inbox opens the Story, and tapping it again joins the LIVE. It starts off (#233).
* With `Record LIVEs you watch` on, a LIVE room's Share sheet has a `LIVE recording quality` row. Tap it to pick the quality the next recording uses without going to Hushfeed settings (#203).
* With `Offer LIVE quality in more rooms` on, Share > Video quality also shows in gaming and football LIVE rooms. TikTok left it out of LIVE Studio rooms and rooms that support low latency (#37).
* In dark mode, the newer Video quality picker in a LIVE room's menu is readable again. Its rows sit on a white card, and Original, 1080p and the rest came out light on it, so they were hard to make out. They turn dark on the card now (#57).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a LIVE room stays dark when your phone switches between light and dark while the room is open. Before, its Share sheet opened white until you left and came back (#159).
* New switch under Share sheet: `Allow Add to Story anyway`. When a creator turned off content reuse, it brings back Add to Story in the share sheet (the button in the row of actions and your story's bubble at the start of Send to) and on their stories, like `Allow Duet and Stitch` does for those two. TikTok may still refuse the post (#88).
* With Region spoof's `Match locale and timezone` on, chat date headers follow the preset's time zone now instead of the phone's clock (#184, #198).
* New `Turn on Thoughts` switch in Hushfeed settings > App. It shows Thoughts on profiles and in your inbox, plus the prompt to share one, for accounts TikTok left out. It starts off, and TikTok's servers can still refuse a post (#186).
* `Keep photos as TikTok sent them` now also covers stickers that don't move, and `Download original photos` keeps TikTok's own file when it's on (#229).
* `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` now also covers the front flash and the fill light, which used to push the screen to full brightness on their own. The flash still turns the screen white, just at your own brightness (#200).

## Update

Refresh the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

## Checked

* This exact bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.5.3 and run on a signed-in emulator. A walk through the whole app opened all 27 of its screens with no crash.
* Every patch applied to TikTok 47.5.3, and 94 applied to PineDrama 47.5.3 with none failing.
* An imported font drew PineDrama's settings and its drama feed after a restart, and bold titles stayed bold (#243).
* Sorting @natgeo's grid oldest first kept loading on its own up to 300 videos, and a tapped video opened that same video (#180).
* `Save the frame on screen as a photo` saved clean 720x1280 frames from a For You video and from a profile video.
* With `Automatic Clear display` on, a search result opened a second time cleared again (#84).
* With `Double tap` set to `Do nothing`, a tap paused or played in 8 to 43 ms, and two taps 150 ms apart paused and then played (#239).

Here's every report this release changed something for, and what changed.

For bug reports

* Repeats in For You (#172). `Hide videos you have already seen` checks each new For You page once TikTok hands it over, so videos you watched stop coming back.
* The comment bar on photo posts (#171). With `AMOLED dark theme`, the `Add comment...` bar under a photo post is black instead of letting the photo show through.
* Fonts on PineDrama (#243). `Use an imported font` now draws PineDrama's text in your font, and bold text stays bold.
* Missing saved stickers (#214). PineDrama's sticker panel loads every sticker you saved. It used to stop at 100.
* Low download quality (#240). When the quality list stops below 720p, it also offers the video's own H.264 or HEVC file if that one is taller, and the diagnostic report shows why each quality was or wasn't offered.
* Commenter countries (#201). `Show where commenters are from` remembers people's countries from their earlier comments and videos, so it finds one more often.
* Running out of memory while patching (#220). The README says to give morphe-desktop 2 GB with `java -Xmx2g`.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). A search result you open again clears again, even if you brought its buttons back by hand last time.

For feature requests

* PineDrama (#156). It moves to 47.5.3, six more patches run on it, and a new `Allow photo comments` patch lets the comment box ask TikTok's server about photo comments like TikTok does. Hushfeed's settings also say to restart PineDrama now, not TikTok.
* A spam shield for comments (#187). `Hide spam comments` hides the bots that point you to their bio or hand out a contact, and leaves the creator's own comments alone.
* Effects that refuse older phones (#176). `Report a newer phone to effects` tells the effects server you have a Galaxy S24 Ultra.
* Saving LIVEs (#37). `LIVE recording source` can record the screen as you watch, and Share > Video quality now shows in gaming and football rooms too.
* LIVE recording presets (#203). `LIVE recording quality` offers Original, 1080p, 720p, 540p and 360p and takes a room's 60 fps stream when it has one. You can change it from a LIVE room's Share sheet too.
* The liquid glass bar (#231). `Blur the video behind the bar` frosts the pill with the video under it, and the lens slides between tabs every time now.
* Dark LIVE rooms (#159). The light bits left in rooms turn dark, from the profile card's tiles to the menu's navigation bar, and a room stays dark when your phone switches themes.
* The Auto scroll switch on foldables (#234). `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` hides the switch beside the avatar too, with or without Auto-advance.
* OmerKurdi79's batch (#232). Clear display lets go with your swipe, and the See-through bottom bar no longer drops the caption over the tabs after each swipe.
* An instant pause (#239). With double tap set to do nothing, a tap pauses or plays the moment your finger lifts.
* Latest on Following (#226). `Latest first` keeps everything below your video in date order as posts load, and the tab starts on the newest post.
* Better sorting (#180). Profile grids get Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid loads up to 300 videos by itself, and swiping through them keeps that order.
* Stories from LIVE creators (#233). `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` opens their Story from their profile picture or your chat with them, and the next tap joins the LIVE.
* LIVE quality in dark mode (#57). The newer Video quality picker in a LIVE room's menu is readable on dark mode.
* Add to Story (#88). `Allow Add to Story anyway` brings the button back when a creator turned off content reuse.
* Time zones (#184, #198). With `Match locale and timezone` on, chat dates follow the preset's zone.
* Thoughts (#186). `Turn on Thoughts` shows Thoughts for accounts TikTok left out.
* Original image formats (#229). Stickers that don't move are saved as TikTok sent them too.
* Camera brightness (#200). `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` also covers the front flash and the fill light.
* Region locked features (#98). Feature Gate Lab's `Scrolling comments on videos` preset says up front that only some videos get scrolling comments.

## What's changed

* On PineDrama, Hushfeed's settings now tell you to restart PineDrama instead of TikTok. That covers the note under each switch, the restart button that shows up once you flip one, the saved message and the Feature Gate Lab, in English and all nine translations. Other mentions of TikTok, like its servers or the TikTok Sans font, stay as they are (#156).
* New `Hide spam comments` switch in Hushfeed settings > Comments, off by default (#187). It hides bot comments that send you to their profile or a "link in bio", spell out a website, hand out a Telegram or WhatsApp contact, or offer free followers. It knows the common phrasings in English and the languages Hushfeed's settings come in, plus French. Your own comments stay, and so do the creator's and any they pinned or liked, so a "part 2 in my bio" from the creator still shows.
* `Hide videos you have already seen` takes watched videos out of For You again (#172). TikTok reads each new page once before handing it to the feed. The switch sits that first read out, as it does on lists you open yourself, but everything the read kept was then remembered as allowed and never checked again. Now the page gets checked against what you've watched once TikTok hands it over, and your watch record starts loading during that first read so it's ready in time.
* With AMOLED dark theme, the `Add comment...` bar under a photo post you open from search, a profile or a link is black now (#171). TikTok leaves that bar see-through, and a photo runs on underneath it, so the photo showed through where a video post shows black.
* `Use an imported font` now works on PineDrama (#243). PineDrama doesn't carry TikTok's own fonts, so its text fell back to your phone's font and the imported one never got used. It now draws in your font at the weight the app asked for, so bold text stays bold.
* Feature Gate Lab's `Scrolling comments on videos` preset tells you before you apply it that comments only scroll on videos TikTok has turned them on for. Each video carries its own flag from TikTok's server, so most videos look the same with the preset on (#98).
* New `Allow photo comments` patch for PineDrama, with its switch off by default (#156). PineDrama hides the gallery tab in the comment box for everyone, even though TikTok's server allows photo comments. Turn the switch on in Hushfeed settings > Comments and restart, and the comment box asks the server like TikTok does.
* PineDrama moves to 47.5.3 and 47.4.3 is dropped, so grab the new PineDrama from APKMirror before you patch it again. Six more patches run on it now: `Advanced downloads`, `Automatic video advance`, `Hide inbox items`, `Hide profile shortcuts`, `Open the comments at full height` and `Show the progress bar`. PineDrama 47.5.3 has no stories, HD upload choice or foldable comment panel, so `Story controls`, `Always upload in HD` and `Foldable split comment view` are TikTok only now. That makes 95 patches Morphe Manager offers for PineDrama. The rest lean on TikTok's LIVE rooms, feed buttons or resources that PineDrama doesn't have (#156).
* New `Report a newer phone to effects` switch, off by default (#176). Effects ask TikTok's server whether your phone can run them, and on some older phones the answer is "This effect doesn't work on this device". With the switch on, the effects server is told you have a Galaxy S24 Ultra. Sign-in and everything else still see your real phone. An effect your phone really can't run may still fail or look wrong.
* New `Load all saved stickers` patch, with no switch. PineDrama's sticker panel loaded only the first 100 stickers you saved and never asked for more, so the rest were missing from Saved. It now asks for all of them in one go. TikTok gets the same first request, and it still loads more by itself past that (#214).
* New `LIVE recording source` choice under `Record LIVEs you watch`. `Stream only` saves the room's own video like before. `Screen` records what your phone shows while you watch. Android asks to allow screen recording each time, and Stop saves it. The app's sound comes along when TikTok has the microphone permission, otherwise the recording is video only (#37).
* New `Blur the video behind the bar` switch under `Liquid glass look`. It frosts the glass pill with a soft blur of the video behind it, off by default, on Android 12 and up (#231).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the light pieces left in a LIVE room go dark too. The navigation bar under the menu a long press in a room opens stays dark now, even when TikTok turns it light again. The tiles in the host's profile card and the fan club's tab strip and card turn dark, and the text and icons on them turn light so they stay readable (#159).
* `Tag saved videos with their details` now tags the videos TikTok actually sends. Their files carry a short list of TikTok's own fields where the tags go, and the switch left those files alone, so every save came out with no title, creator, date or link. The tags go in now, and TikTok's fields stay in the file beside them.
* `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the Auto scroll switch that tablets and unfolded foldables show beside the avatar on each video, and it works with `Auto-advance videos` off now. Before, that switch stayed, and the hide only worked while Auto-advance was on (#234).
* The README's install steps now say which 47.5.3 file to get. Morphe Manager on a phone should patch the bundle (`.apkm`), because on a device with 3 GB Manager ran out of memory on the APK and patched the bundle in about a minute. A computer should patch the APK. The out of memory tip under Patching stalls partway points to the bundle too, and step 6 says to uninstall the Google Play TikTok first, which logs you out.
* With `Keep Clear display across videos` off, the tabs, the caption and the buttons now come back as your swipe lets go, so the next video arrives with them. Before, it settled full screen first and then jumped when they showed up again. A Clear display you turn on from TikTok's long-press menu also stays on now instead of switching itself off as the menu closes (#232).
* With `See-through bottom bar` on, the caption, the buttons and the search bar don't drop down over the tabs for a moment after each swipe anymore (#232).
* Long press set to `Save the frame on screen as a photo` works again on 47.5.3. TikTok's player now draws each video into a layer of its own under the feed, so the save only found an empty view and said the frame couldn't be read. It reads the player's layer now, and the photo comes out at the video's own size with no caption or buttons, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile.
* `Remove feed ads` also takes out the smaller Lemon8 card in For You, the one titled "Your daily dose of inspiration" with a Lemon8 post and Open Lemon8 under it. It's built differently from the full-screen Lemon8 card the switch already removed, so it slipped through on 47.5.3.
* The `Show how many were filtered` label and the `Show what is left of the budget` label stay off the Shop tab and the Nearby tab now. Both showed there because the Home tab stays selected on those tabs, and the filtered count sat right over their search boxes. They still show on For You and Following.
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a room's viewer ranking opens dark again. A shop room's Top customers ranking still keeps TikTok's light look, because its tab titles came out dark on dark (#159).
* The README says how much memory morphe-desktop needs on a computer. With every patch picked on 47.5.3 it runs out at 1 GB, Java's default on a 4 GB machine, and finishes at 1.5 GB, so start it with `java -Xmx2g` (#220).
* With `Double tap` set to `Do nothing`, or every corner of `Double tap by corner` set to it, a tap on a video pauses or plays the moment your finger lifts. TikTok used to hold each tap for a beat in case a second one followed, and two quick taps counted as a double tap that did nothing. Now each one counts (#239).
* The build uses Gradle 9.8.2, up from 9.7.1. The build files now name the Guava advisory by its CVE number, CVE-2026-102554, because GitHub's global advisory database doesn't list its GHSA id.
* The README now lists the parts of Hushfeed's settings that an add-on bundle patched in beside it can count on, and a test fails if one of them changes. Anything else in the settings code can still move between releases.
* What's new now carries only the newest releases' notes, and its Full changelog button has the rest. Every release since 0.60.0 used to be built in, in all nine languages, and those notes alone were about 14% of the extension's size.
* `Glass lens on the current tab` slides to the next tab even after you've sat on one tab for a while, or when TikTok takes a moment to open a tab for the first time. Before, it only slid when you tapped quickly, and in both of those cases it jumped instead (#231).
* With `Automatic Clear display` on, a search result you open again from TikTok's own search clears again, even when you brought its buttons back by hand the last time you watched it. Before, it remembered that and stayed uncleared (#84).
* `LIVE recording quality` also offers the presets from a LIVE room's own quality menu: Original, 1080p, 720p, 540p and 360p. If the room doesn't have the one you picked, the recording takes the closest one below it, or the closest above when nothing lower is there. A room's 60 fps streams count as the quality they're in, so 1080p in a 1080p60 room records the 60 fps stream instead of falling back to 720p (#203).
* When the Download quality list stops below 720p, it now also offers the video's own H.264 or HEVC version if that one is taller. The diagnostic report has a new section for the last video you opened the list on, with each quality it offered and why any others were left out (#240).
* `Show where commenters are from` finds a country more often. It remembers someone's country from their earlier comments and from videos of theirs you scrolled past, and it reads one more of the country fields TikTok sends with an account (#201).
* `Latest first` on the Following tab now keeps everything below the video you're watching in date order as more posts load. A newer post that shows up late moves up right after your video, and nothing you've already scrolled past moves. It also asks TikTok for twice as many posts on the first load, so a newer post is less likely to turn up after the first video is already playing. When TikTok opens fresh, it no longer starts the Following tab on the post it saved from last time, which was usually older than everything loading under it. The first video now comes from the new, sorted list (#226).
* Sorting a profile or Liked grid now has Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid keeps loading by itself (up to 300 videos) so the order covers more than the first screen, and a button in the grid's corner changes the order right there. When you open a video from a sorted grid, swiping up goes on in the grid's order too, where it used to follow TikTok's. On the Liked tab the button sits under TikTok's note about who can see your liked videos instead of covering it (#180).
* New switch under `Remove avatar rings`: `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE`. When someone who's LIVE also has a Story, tapping their picture on their profile or on your chat with them in the Inbox opens the Story, and tapping it again joins the LIVE. It starts off (#233).
* With `Record LIVEs you watch` on, a LIVE room's Share sheet has a `LIVE recording quality` row. Tap it to pick the quality the next recording uses without going to Hushfeed settings (#203).
* With `Offer LIVE quality in more rooms` on, Share > Video quality also shows in gaming and football LIVE rooms. TikTok left it out of LIVE Studio rooms and rooms that support low latency (#37).
* In dark mode, the newer Video quality picker in a LIVE room's menu is readable again. Its rows sit on a white card, and Original, 1080p and the rest came out light on it, so they were hard to make out. They turn dark on the card now (#57).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a LIVE room stays dark when your phone switches between light and dark while the room is open. Before, its Share sheet opened white until you left and came back (#159).
* New switch under Share sheet: `Allow Add to Story anyway`. When a creator turned off content reuse, it brings back Add to Story in the share sheet (the button in the row of actions and your story's bubble at the start of Send to) and on their stories, like `Allow Duet and Stitch` does for those two. TikTok may still refuse the post (#88).
* With Region spoof's `Match locale and timezone` on, chat date headers follow the preset's time zone now instead of the phone's clock (#184, #198).
* New `Turn on Thoughts` switch in Hushfeed settings > App. It shows Thoughts on profiles and in your inbox, plus the prompt to share one, for accounts TikTok left out. It starts off, and TikTok's servers can still refuse a post (#186).
* `Keep photos as TikTok sent them` now also covers stickers that don't move, and `Download original photos` keeps TikTok's own file when it's on (#229).
* `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` now also covers the front flash and the fill light, which used to push the screen to full brightness on their own. The flash still turns the screen white, just at your own brightness (#200).

## Update

Refresh the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

## Checked

* This exact bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.5.3 and run on a signed-in emulator. A walk through the whole app opened all 27 of its screens with no crash.
* Every patch applied to TikTok 47.5.3, and 94 applied to PineDrama 47.5.3 with none failing.
* An imported font drew PineDrama's settings and its drama feed after a restart, and bold titles stayed bold (#243).
* Sorting @natgeo's grid oldest first kept loading on its own up to 300 videos, and a tapped video opened that same video (#180).
* `Save the frame on screen as a photo` saved clean 720x1280 frames from a For You video and from a profile video.
* With `Automatic Clear display` on, a search result opened a second time cleared again (#84).
* With `Double tap` set to `Do nothing`, a tap paused or played in 8 to 43 ms, and two taps 150 ms apart paused and then played (#239).

hushgram.title: v0.0.18
hushgram.body:
HushGram moves to Instagram 453.0.0.57.79 and Morphe patcher 2.1.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. Feed videos and reels can stop looping, feed videos get a seek bar, and a reel can show its whole picture with black bars instead of being cut off. Carousels can have arrows, chats can be pinned or exported as text, and a viewing history can stay on your phone. Among the fixes, `Tab bar layout` and `Hide Featured in notifications` work on Instagram 453 again, and `Pure black dark mode` now reaches the startup screen and HushGram's own settings.

New in this release

- `Stop videos looping` is a new patch under Playback. Feed videos and reels stop on their last frame instead of playing again. Reels still loop while auto scroll is on, so it can move on. It starts off. Asked for in #248 and #175.

- `Hide Subscribe on profiles` and `Hide the arrow at the end of the buttons` are new under Profiles. The other buttons fill the row, and the arrow's menu goes with it. Both start off. Asked for in #248.

- `Skip the contacts and location popups` is a new patch. With its switch on under Ads and privacy, the screens asking you to sync contacts and turn on location stop opening at every start. It starts off. Asked for in #295, #329 and #421.

- `Emoji style` gets `Emoji pack` under Layout. Keep your phone's emoji, download Twemoji, OpenMoji or Blobmoji, or pick a color emoji font, then restart Instagram. A pack only switches in once its download checks out. Asked for in #166.

- `Smooth story opening` is a new patch under Stories. A story you tap in the stories row zooms open more slowly and stops without the little bounce at the end, and it closes the same way. It starts off. Asked for in #409.

- `App-only proxy` is a new patch under Ads and privacy. Type an HTTP proxy's address and port in `Proxy server`, restart, and only Instagram goes through it. It takes plain HTTP proxies that need no password. Starts off. Asked for in #219.

- `Copy text button on reels` and `Copy text button on stories` add a Lens icon that opens Google Lens on the reel or story to copy its words. Without the Google app it opens the share sheet. Both start off. Asked for in #303.

- `Ambient light in stories` is a new switch under Stories. A story that doesn't fill the screen gets a soft glow in its own colors in the black bands, and it changes with each photo or video. Starts off. Asked for in #420.

- `Ambient light` is a new patch under Feed, off to start. Posts in Home and Following glow softly in their own colors, and so do the bands around a reel that doesn't fill the screen. Asked for in #416.

- `Carousel arrows` is a new patch. Its switch under Feed puts a back and a next arrow on a carousel post, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without swiping. It starts off. Asked for in #417.

- `Carousel arrows` gets `Page dots on a pill`, a new switch right under the arrows. A carousel's page dots move onto a round pill at the bottom, with your page in blue. Starts off. Asked for in #419.

- `Keep Home's top bar` gets `See-through top bar`, a new switch right under it. Home's top bar turns to frosted glass and your posts show through it as they scroll, whether the bar stays or slides away. Needs a restart. Asked for in #418.

- `Hide ads` now hides the ad that shows up among a post's or reel's comments too. Asked for in #415.

- In `Stop Reels scrolling`, `Stop after 20 reels` is now `Stop after a set number of reels`. Sliders pick the count (5 to 100) and how long Instagram sits in the background before swiping works again (5 to 120 minutes). Asked for in #405.

- `Keep a viewing history` under Ads and privacy keeps a list of the posts, reels, stories and profiles you looked at, on this phone only. `Clear viewing history` empties it. Starts off. Asked for in #228.

- The `App icon` list now shows each choice's real icon in its own colors next to its name, with the one in use marked, so you can see what you're picking before you leave Instagram. Asked for in #321 and #327.

- The `Accent color` list on Android 11 and older marks the color in use again.

- On Android 11 and older, `Material You` now stays in the `Color` list, greyed out, with the reason on it. Before, it just wasn't there. Asked for in #187 and #264.

- `Clean up Reels` adds `Start every reel in clear mode` under `Keep clear mode on`, so reels open in clear mode with no tap. Instagram blocks screenshots there unless `Allow screenshots` is on. Starts off. Asked for in #138.

- `Icons in the accent color` is a new switch under `Accent color`, off to start. After a restart the top bar, profile, tab bar and post icons take your color. Text keeps its own. Asked for in #8.

- `Explore without personalization` is a new patch for the EU, where Instagram offers that grid. One switch under Explore opens it every time. Another hides its menu button. Both start off. Asked for in #311.

- `Keep Featured off the heart's dot` under Notifications stops a Featured item from lighting the red dot on the heart. Likes, comments and follows still do. Starts off. Asked for in #189.

- `Pinned chats` under Messages pins the chat you opened last to the top of your inbox. Pins stay on this phone, per account, and the same row unpins them. Asked for in #345.

- `App icon` adds Hand-drawn Instagram, a pencil sketch of Instagram's glyph on white. Themed icons show the same sketch. Asked for in #406.

- `Chat history tools` is a new patch. Its switch under Messages lets you long press a chat's name to jump to its first message or a date, loading older messages with a count and Cancel. Starts off. Asked for in #246.

- `Chat history tools` gets a second switch, `Export a chat as text`. Long press a chat's name and pick Export chat to save the whole chat to Downloads/HushGram, one line per message. Starts off. Asked for in #247.

- `Save comment photo` gets a second switch under Comments, `Reply with a comment's GIF`. A comment's menu gets a row that sends its GIF back as your reply, animated. Starts off. Asked for in #402.

- `Use the highest refresh rate` is a new patch. Its switch, under Layout, asks Android to run Instagram at your screen's fastest refresh rate at the same resolution. It takes effect the moment you flip it, no restart. Starts off. Asked for in #401.

- `Read messages without the seen receipt` gets a switch, `Mark a chat seen when you reply`. Replying lets that person see you read their earlier messages. Chats you don't answer stay unseen. Starts off. Reported in #365.

- `Hide captions` is a new patch. Its switch, under Feed, takes the caption off feed posts and reels and leaves the post. The comments sheet still shows it. Off to start. Asked for in #395.

- `Keep Home's top bar` is a new patch. Its switch under Feed keeps the Instagram logo and its buttons at the top of Home while you scroll. Restart Instagram after you flip it. Starts off. Asked for in #408, #367 and #223.

- `Keep the Reels top bar` is a new patch. Its switch, under Reels, keeps the Reels title, the Friends tab and the buttons beside them at the top while you swipe through reels. No restart needed. Starts off. Asked for in #411.

- `Mark one-time photos and videos` is a new patch. Its switch, under Messages, puts a border and Instagram's view once icon on one-time photos and videos in a chat. Only the look changes. Starts off. Asked for in #165.

- `Pinch to zoom on Reels` is a new patch. Its switch, `Pinch to zoom` under Reels, lets two fingers zoom into a playing reel the way a photo zooms, and it goes back when you lift them. Starts off. Asked for in #382.

- `HushGram settings` adds `Descriptions behind an info button` under Settings entry. It shows each switch by name alone, with a small i to tap for what it does. Off to start. Asked for in #130.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` adds `Stop after the chat's reels` under Messages, which ends reels you open from a chat at the last one shared there. No suggested reels follow. Starts off. Asked for in #390.

- In `Download any video`, Copy media link under Details now says the link stops working after a few days, since Instagram's file addresses expire. Asked for in #364.

- The source audit waits out a rate limit for as long as the forge's Retry-After asks, up to five minutes. A longer one, like GitLab's hourly limit, fails that source at once and says when it resets.
